jobs.description:
**Job Description

**

Head of Marketing - Nordics and UK

Posting Start Date: 9/9/26

Gentofte, 83, DNK, 2820

**Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK

**

• Location: Gentofte, Copenhagen, Denmark

• Working hours: Full-time

• Work model: Hybrid

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

• Travel: Regular travel across our markets, particularly the Nordics and the UK

Are you passionate about turning brand and commercial strategy into activation that drives real impact with consumers? Do you want to be the critical link between Brand Marketing and Commercial teams across the Nordics and the UK? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK, you will be part of the Trade & Activation team and play an important role in translating brand and commercial strategies into impactful market activation plans that drive adult consumer engagement, strengthen brand equity and deliver commercial growth across the Nordic and UK markets. You will work closely with Brand Marketing and Commercial teams to ensure our brands come to life consistently and effectively across channels, customers and consumer touchpoints. Reporting to the Trade & Activation Director for Europe, you will lead and develop a team of 7 direct reports. This is a great opportunity to act as the critical link between brand strategy and commercial execution in an international organization.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**In this role, you will typically focus on:

• Own the activation agenda for our Nordic and UK markets, translating brand and commercial priorities and channel-specific strategies into impactful market programs.

• Develop and execute annual activation plans that drive adult consumer recruitment, engagement, retention and brand preference across the portfolio.

• Partner closely with Sales and Key Account teams to build customer activation plans that strengthen distribution, visibility, conversion and category growth.

• Translate consumer, shopper and market insights into activation programs that create measurable commercial impact.

• Manage the development and deployment of activation toolkits, point-of-sale materials and execution standards to ensure consistent market execution.

• Monitor activation performance, evaluate ROI and continuously optimize investment allocation, contributing to annual commercial planning.

**What You'll Bring

**

• Significant experience in Brand Activation, Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, Consumer Engagement or Commercial Marketing, ideally within tobacco, nicotine, FMCG, beverages or other regulated consumer goods industries.

• A proven track record of developing and executing activation programs that deliver measurable commercial results, with a strong understanding of consumer behavior, shopper dynamics and route-to-market strategies.

• A commercially driven mindset, with experience managing activation budgets and optimizing resource allocation across multiple markets to connect investment to business performance and ROI.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Insights and external agency partners, operating effectively within matrix organizations.

• A proactive, growth-oriented attitude with a passion for excellence in execution and continuous improvement.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English and a Nordic language.

**Working At STG & What To Expect

**At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

**Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

• Recruiter screen

• Interview with the hiring team

• Assessment, case study, or work sample, if relevant

• Final interview with leadership or key stakeholders

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

_Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

Restaurant Operations Manager

About Us

At Bagel Bites, we believe that good food, excellent customer service, and efficient restaurant management go hand in hand.

Following a restructuring of our management team, we are looking for a responsible, motivated, and flexible employee to take charge of the restaurant's daily operations.

The position combines restaurant management, kitchen duties, customer service, purchasing, and administrative responsibilities. The successful candidate must be willing to take an active role in all aspects of the restaurant's operations, including physically working in the kitchen.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the overall daily operation of the restaurant. Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Managing and coordinating the restaurant's daily operations.

• 
Supervising employees, delegating tasks, preparing work schedules, and ensuring efficient teamwork.

• 
Preparing and serving fast food, including sandwiches, burgers, bagels, and other menu items.

• 
Actively participating in kitchen activities, food preparation, cleaning, and maintaining hygiene standards.

• 
Purchasing raw materials, ingredients, and other necessary supplies for the restaurant.

• 
Managing inventory, monitoring stock levels, and ensuring the availability of necessary ingredients.

• 
Handling customer service, taking orders, and resolving customer inquiries or complaints.

• 
Developing and implementing marketing initiatives to promote the restaurant.

• 
Managing the company's social media accounts and online presence.

• 
Assisting with financial and administrative tasks, including budgeting, sales monitoring, reporting, and basic accounting.

• 
Ensuring compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene requirements, and company procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for a candidate who has:

• 
Relevant education or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, or the food service industry.

• 
Experience in kitchen operations and fast-food preparation.

• 
Good organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to manage employees and delegate responsibilities.

• 
Strong customer service and communication skills.

• 
Knowledge of purchasing, inventory management, and supplier coordination.

• 
Basic understanding of financial administration and accounting.

• 
Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and handle multiple tasks.

• 
A flexible and hands-on approach, with willingness to perform both managerial and practical kitchen duties.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to:

Email: info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com

Please use the subject line: "Application – Restaurant Operations Manager".

 

 

 

Restaurantdriftsleder

Om os

Hos Bagel Bites mener vi, at god mad, fremragende kundeservice og effektiv restaurantledelse går hånd i hånd.

Efter en mindre omstrukturering af vores ledelsesteam søger vi nu en ansvarsbevidst, motiveret og fleksibel medarbejder, der kan varetage ansvaret for restaurantens daglige drift.

Stillingen omfatter en kombination af restaurantledelse, køkkenarbejde, kundeservice, indkøb og administrative opgaver. Den rette kandidat skal være indstillet på at deltage aktivt i alle dele af restaurantens drift, herunder også praktisk arbejde i køkkenet.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområder

Som Restaurantdriftsleder får du ansvaret for den overordnede daglige drift af restauranten. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil omfatte:

• 
At lede og koordinere restaurantens daglige drift.

• 
At føre tilsyn med medarbejderne, uddelegere arbejdsopgaver, udarbejde arbejdsplaner og sikre et effektivt samarbejde i teamet.

• 
At tilberede og servere fastfood, herunder sandwiches, burgere, bagels og andre menuprodukter.

• 
At deltage aktivt i køkkenarbejdet, herunder madlavning, klargøring af råvarer, rengøring og overholdelse af hygiejnestandarder.

• 
At stå for indkøb af råvarer, ingredienser og øvrige nødvendige forsyninger til restauranten.

• 
At administrere lagerbeholdningen, overvåge lagerstatus og sikre, at de nødvendige råvarer altid er tilgængelige.

• 
At varetage kundeservice, modtage bestillinger og håndtere kundehenvendelser og eventuelle klager.

• 
At udvikle og gennemføre markedsføringsinitiativer med henblik på at promovere restauranten.

• 
At administrere virksomhedens sociale medier og online tilstedeværelse.

• 
At bidrage til økonomiske og administrative opgaver, herunder budgettering, overvågning af omsætning, rapportering og grundlæggende regnskabsopgaver.

• 
At sikre, at gældende fødevaresikkerhedsregler, hygiejnekrav og virksomhedens interne procedurer overholdes.

Kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Vi søger en kandidat, der har følgende kvalifikationer og kompetencer:

• 
Relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring inden for restaurantledelse, hotel- og restaurationsbranchen eller fødevarebranchen.

• 
Erfaring med køkkendrift og tilberedning af fastfood.

• 
Gode organisatoriske og ledelsesmæssige evner samt erfaring med personaleledelse og uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver.

• 
Gode kommunikations- og kundeservicekompetencer.

• 
Kendskab til indkøb, lagerstyring og koordinering med leverandører.

• 
Grundlæggende forståelse for økonomisk administration og regnskab.

• 
Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og håndtere flere forskellige arbejdsopgaver.

• 
En fleksibel og praktisk tilgang til arbejdet samt villighed til både at varetage ledelsesmæssige opgaver og deltage aktivt i køkkenets daglige arbejde.

Ansøgning

Hvis du mener, at dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer matcher vores krav, opfordrer vi dig til at sende din ansøgning og dit CV til en af følgende e-mailadresser:

E-mail: info@sundsult.dk eller rkbgaps@gmail.com

Join a fast-growing international MedTech company and take a central role in turning AI ambitions into practical, adopted solutions across the organisation.

As AI Lead, you will join Contura's IT & Projects organisation and report to the Head of IT.

In this newly established role, you will take ownership of the AI roadmap and use-case portfolio and help move AI initiatives from pilot to production.

Working across business and IT, you will drive adoption, build internal AI capability and ensure that initiatives create business value while meeting relevant quality and compliance requirements.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own and drive Contura's AI roadmap, use-case portfolio and implementation plan.

• Translate business needs into qualified use cases, requirements and solution proposals.

• Take successful AI and digital solutions from pilot into controlled production.

• Build internal AI capability through training, workshops and an AI community of champions and key users.

• Coordinate external specialists and contribute to pragmatic AI governance together with IT, Quality and Regulatory Affairs.

_Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

_The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

You will play a key role in the end-to-end performance reporting cycle, turning performance trends and underlying drivers into sharp insights, recommendations and actions. Working closely with Group Reporting & Accounting, Group Commercial Finance and stakeholders across Pandora, you will combine strong financial foundations with sound business judgement to turn complexity into clarity.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously develop Pandora’s end-to-end Group performance reporting, including clear and decision-relevant commentary.

• Lead the preparation of the monthly and quarterly Group Business Performance Reviews and closing reviews delivering a high-quality reporting pack that clearly highlights key results, business drivers, risks and opportunities.

• Prepare executive and Board reporting, translating financial information into concise, actionable insights.

• Coordinate FP&A activities related to monthly, quarterly and annual closing in close partnership with Group Reporting & Accounting and other Finance teams.

• Analyze performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, including key drivers across revenue, gross margin, costs and cash flow.

• Play a key role in the governance and reporting of like-for-like performance, including system logic and definitions, ensuring LFL is consistently applied as a key performance measure.

• Serve as the centre of excellence for Group reporting methodology and the management reporting package, ensuring one set of numbers

• Partner with our Global Cost Transformation office on reporting and follow-up of initiatives and financial benefits.

• Continuously improve the structure, content and quality of Group performance reporting and commentary, driving simplification, standardization and automation across reporting processes and ways of working.

**What We’re Looking For

**You are a business-minded finance professional with a strong technical foundations and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a compelling executive-level performance story.

**What You Bring

**

• Relevant experience from a similar role within Group Finance, FP&A or controlling in a larger international organization.

• A robust accounting foundation and a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, including working capital.

• Experience with monthly closing, Group consolidation, management reporting and performance-review processes.

• Proven ability to translate financial results into clear, concise insights for CFO and/or Board-level audiences.

• Sound business acumen and judgement, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and focus on what matters most.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

• A proactive mindset, anticipating needs and raising issues and opportunities early rather than simply reacting to requests.

• A track record of improving, simplifying or automating finance and reporting processes, supported by advanced systems, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Comfort working in a complex international environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Additional Information

**

• Career Band 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued.

Build Continia’s test function from the ground up, and shape how we deliver quality across all our products.

Continia develops finance automation software built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, .NET, web and mobile technologies. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 20,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 1,800 reselling partners.

As our products grow and increasingly ship together as a Continia Suite, quality across them matters more than ever. That is why we are building a new test function, and we are looking for the person who will lead it. You will set the direction, build the processes and lay the foundation for the team.

About the role

Our developers own the quality of their own code through unit and integration tests. What no single team owns today is the view across products. Does a change in one product affect another? Does the Continia Suite work as a whole? Are we ready to release? That is what this function is for, and you will be the one to build it.

You start by creating the roadmap. Where are our biggest quality challenges, which processes do we need, and what are the milestones? From there you build the function step by step. You keep it transparent where we are and when we need people from the product teams. You will work closely with our QA & Automation Engineer to decide what to automate and where AI can make our test processes faster.

A big part of the role is people. You will be the link between support, escalation engineers, developers and product managers. You listen to what they see, bring the right people together and turn what you learn into better testing.

What you’ll be doing

• Build the test function from scratch, including the roadmap, milestones, processes and, over time, the team.

• Define test strategy, quality criteria and release readiness with product managers and engineering managers.

• Own regression and coordinate testing across our all our products, so nothing is skipped before we ship.

• Work closely with support, escalation engineers, developers and product managers, and turn what they see into better testing.

• Work with UX to make sure new features are easy to understand and intuitive for users, not just that they meet the user story.

• Find the edge cases others miss, and match test depth to risk.

• Report quality trends and progress to leadership.

About you

• Experience leading QA or test work, ideally including building a test function or team from the ground up.

• Extensive software testing experience or QA, including test strategy for complex business applications.

• Practical experience using AI to improve test processes.

• Experience with ERP or finance software. Dynamics 365 Business Central is a strong advantage.

• Structured by nature. You create clarity, set up processes that last, and can say “not ready” with evidence while staying a good colleague to the teams you work with.

• ISTQB or a similar certification is an advantage.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken. Danish language skills are an advantage, but not required.

What we offer

At Continia, you’ll join an informal and collaborative environment where you’ll be empowered to grow professionally and personally.

• Competitive compensation package.

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously.

• Opportunities for professional growth and learning.

• A strong social environment where we celebrate successes and have fun together.

• Memorable company events with colleagues from around the world.

• Work at the intersection of technology and business, with an impact you can see.

The position is based at our office in Aalborg, and we expect you to be on site three days a week. The role is about working closely with support, developers and product teams, and being close to them makes it easier to keep a finger on the pulse and build strong relationships.

How to apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please upload your CV along with a short motivation for your application.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. For questions about the position, please contact Senior Product Manager, Josefine Franck Christensen at jf@continia.com.

Continia is committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all applicants with a Danish residence and work permit.

For GDPR and processing reasons, all applications and CVs must be uploaded via the provided link and not sent via email or otherwise.

About Continia

At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other’s thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented, and we aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim to have one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place.

We recognize that time is what matters most. Continia solutions give customers more time every day to work and live. That’s why “It’s About Time” is our motto. Our success is built on partnering with more than 1,800 reselling partners, serving more than 20,000 customers worldwide.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for an AI Engineer who is, first and foremost, a product builder. In this role, you won't just be running experiments in a notebook; you will own the end-to-end AI strategy and its direct impact on our customers.

In this role, you will own everything related to AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing company. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves solving complex compliance puzzles, and is eager to shape the next generation of compliance technology.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• AI Strategy & Ownership: Own the end-to-end AI roadmap—from selecting the right models (SOTA commercial vs. fine-tuned open source) to deciding how they are integrated into the product core.

• Agentic Feature Design: Design and deploy LLM-powered features including autonomous agents, advanced RAG pipelines, and intelligent document understanding.

• Product-Led AI: Collaborate directly with founders to translate complex compliance "puzzles" into scalable AI solutions. You own the "Why" behind every model choice.

• Continuous Innovation: Stay at the bleeding edge of AI/ML research, proactively identifying new papers or releases that can give spektr a competitive advantage.

• Engineering for Reliability: Turn non-deterministic AI outputs into deterministic product value. You ensure our agents are accurate, explainable, and hallucination-free.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Product Mindset: You are a product person at heart. You care about whether the AI actually solves the user's problem, not just if the loss curve is going down.

• High-Agency Builder: You prefer building systems over following manuals. You identify bottlenecks in our AI workflows and fix them before they become tickets.

• AI/ML Expertise: 2+ years of experience in ML, AI, or Data/Backend roles with a deep understanding of modern LLM stacks.

• Technical Mastery: Strong skills in TypeScript (our core) and/or Python, with hands-on experience in frameworks like LangChain or equivalent orchestration layers.

• RAG & Vector Mastery: You’ve built production-grade RAG pipelines and understand the nuances of embedding, retrieval strategy, and re-ranking.

• Evaluation Obsession: You understand that "it works on my machine" doesn't apply to LLMs. You have experience setting up evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

• Cloud & Scale: Experience deploying AI services in AWS or containerized environments, ensuring they are scalable and cost-effective.

• Communication: You can explain the trade-offs of a specific model architecture to a founder and a technical bottleneck to a peer with equal clarity.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Open Source (LLaMA, Mistral).

• Stack: TypeScript, Python, LangChain, etc

• Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD for LLMs.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Shape the future of customer engagement at LEO Pharma — from global design to local impact.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology. At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology, with 115 years of experience bringing innovation to healthcare.

In Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, we partner across the business to drive customer engagement excellence – empowering global and local teams to execute with impact. We are guided by simplification, collaboration, and accountability. Now, as we embark on a global Customer Engagement Platform implementation affecting around 1500 users across 30+ markets. We are preparing to launch a transformation project and are expanding the team with 2 permanent and 3 temporary Senior Global Business Process Owner roles, who will help define how customer engagement works across LEO — and make it simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Your role

You will be the business authority for customer engagement processes within your portfolio. You will be the business voice that connects commercial needs with technical delivery - translating needs into process design, requirements, governance, and adoption. You will work closely with global and local stakeholders – bringing deep respect for the knowledge of people living the day-to-day reality – while driving towards global standards that create value for LEO, our customers, and ultimately patients. When decisions are needed for the greater good of LEO and the patients we serve – you drive them through. Global IT and external partners build to your specifications.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Designing and governing scalable customer engagement processes across global and local markets.

• Facilitating cross-functional workshops and driving alignment across Business Units, Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs, Digital Engagement, and regional teams – and representing your portfolio credibly to senior stakeholders.

• Translating business needs into process flows, user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria with Global IT and external partners.

• Making process design decisions within your portfolio – proceeding when alignment is reached, escalating when it’s not.

• Setting global standards, enabling train-the-trainer models, and ensuring platforms and processes are adopted successfully.

• Owning and prioritising the improvement pipeline, including business cases, benefits, adoption metrics, and continuous optimisation.

You may work across areas such as segmentation, targeting, territory planning, field execution, omnichannel journey enablement (process design, platform configuration and data flow – engagement model and channel strategy are owned by Digital Engagement), Key Account Management, event management, field coaching, analytics, and AI-enabled customer engagement insights.

When you apply, indicate which areas are your primary strength and where you have secondary experience.

Your qualifications

We imagine that you bring solid business process ownership experience from pharmaceutical or life sciences commercial operations. You understand how global platforms support local execution, and you know how to turn ambiguity into clear, practical decisions that move the business forward.

We are especially looking for:

jobs.occupation: PhD Position : Clinical and Multi-Omics Biomarker Discovery and Risk Prediction in Diabetes Compli-cations
jobs.description:
We invite applications for an exciting PhD position within the Bioinformatics and Data Science Team, Complications Research Group, Clinical and Translational Research Department at Steno Diabetes Center Copenhagen (SDCC).

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of clinical research, multi-omics, computational biology and precision medicine, contributing to the discovery of novel biomarkers and improved risk prediction of diabetes-related complications.

About the Complications Research Group

The Complications Research Group is led by a research manager and currently comprises five senior scientists, together with several PhD students and postdoctoral researchers. Our overall aim is to identify novel biomarkers, mechanisms and risk-stratification approaches to improve the prevention and treatment of microvascular and macrovascular complications of diabetes.

The group includes two clinical research teams and a Bioinformatics and Data Science Team. The latter leads and collaborates on national and international research projects focusing on risk stratification and precision medicine in individuals with type 1 and type 2 diabetes. Our research spans several diabetes complications, including neuropathy, brain and cognitive dysfunction, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, diabetic foot disease and retinopathy.

Our research integrates clinical cohort data with multi-omics technologies and advanced bioinformatics, statistical and artificial intelligence approaches. We specialize in human genomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, and proteomics to identify novel disease mechanisms, biomarkers and therapeutic targets, ultimately supporting improved clinical decision-making and personalized medicine.

About the Project

This PhD project will focus on translational biomarker discovery and risk prediction of neurological complications and neurodegeneration in individuals with type 2 diabetes.

The project will involve the acquisition and analysis of metabolomics and lipidomics data from well-characterised clinical cohorts, alongside integration with other molecular and clinical data. You will receive training in omics data processing, multi-modal data integration, computational biology and advanced data science approaches, including machine learning.

Joining our team, you will become an integral part of a multi-omics research initiative within the Complications Research Group, working closely with clinicians and researchers across SDCC. The project will be conducted within the Bioinformatics and Data Science Team, in collaboration with the Type 2 Diabetes and Neuro Unit at SDCC and other research partners.

The Position and Your Responsibilities: As a PhD student, you will take an active role in the planning, execution and dissemination of research findings. Your responsibilities will include:

• Contributing to the acquisition, processing and quality control of metabolomics and lipidomics data.

• Managing and analysing complex clinical and multi-omics datasets.

• Developing and applying computational pipelines for multi-modal data integration, including clinical, imaging and omics data.

• Conducting biomarker discovery, mechanistic investigations and risk-prediction analyses.

• Applying statistical modelling, machine learning and other advanced data science approaches.

• Preparing scientific manuscripts, presenting research findings and contributing to collaborative research activities.

We are looking for a motivated candidate with the following qualifications:

• A Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Biomedical Engineering, Computational Biology, Data Science or a related discipline.

• A strong interest in biomedical research, omics technologies and precision medicine.

• Knowledge of metabolomics and/or lipidomics/proteomics, preferably with experience in omics data analysis and AI/ML implementation within a clinical setting.

• Good programming and analytical skills, preferably in R and/or Python.

• An interest in multi-omics data integration, statistical modelling and machine learning/AI approaches.

Previous research experience, scientific publications and experience with clinical or omics datasets will be considered an advantage.

We particularly welcome candidates who are enthusiastic about combining computational and analytical approaches with clinically relevant research.

What We Offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to develop a research career at the interface of bioinformatics, multi-omics and clinical translational research.

You will benefit from:

• Working in an interdisciplinary research environment with close interaction between bioinformaticians, clinicians and experimental researchers.

• Access to well-characterised clinical cohorts and advanced omics technologies.

• Training in multi-omics data integration, computational biology, machine learning and precision medicine.

• Opportunities to participate in national and international research collaborations involving academia and industry.

• Opportunities to develop independent research ideas, contribute to grant applications and establish your own research profile.

• Formal training and opportunities to develop scientific, project-management and leadership skills.

Recruitment and Employment

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement for Academics employed by the Danish Regions (Danske Regioner) and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

Contact and Application: Applications must be submitted online by 15 December 2026.

Interviews are expected to take place during the following week, with an anticipated starting date of 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

For further information about the position, kindly contact: Associate Professor Tarunveer Singh Ahluwalia, the Bioinformatics and Data Science group lead or Professor Tine W. Hansen, Head of Department, Complications Research, SDCC.

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds who possess the relevant academic qualifications and motivation.

About Steno Diabetes Center Copenhagen

Steno Diabetes Center Copenhagen (SDCC) is a leading centre for diabetes care, research, prevention and education of healthcare professionals. SDCC is the largest diabetes clinic in Scandinavia, providing specialised care to more than 11,000 children and adults with diabetes annually. Through close integration of clinical practice and research, SDCC aims to advance diabetes prevention, treatment and personalised medicine.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professorship at the Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research
jobs.description:
The Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, Department of Psychology and Behavioural Sciences, Aarhus University, invites applications for Associate Professorship in social science alcohol and drug research, commencing 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research is an independent, interdisciplinary social science research centre. As an Associate Professor, you are expected to conduct high-quality research that strengthens the Centre’s research environment and contributes to the development of alcohol and drug research in Denmark. You will be expected to help strengthen the Centre’s international, including Nordic, research profile and collaborative activities within the field.

Candidates are expected to attract external research funding, publish in recognised academic journals and book series, teach at undergraduate and graduate levels, supervise PhD students, and have experience in, or shortly after appointment take responsibility for, leading research projects. There is also an expectation that you actively disseminate alcohol and drug research in a Danish context to practitioners, policymakers, and the general public. Furthermore, it is a requirement that you are based at the Centre on a daily basis and contribute actively and enthusiastically to its interdisciplinary research environment. Administrative duties will also be associated with the position.

Qualifications

Applicants with a social science research background in alcohol and drug studies and related areas will be preferred. Appointment as Associate Professor furthermore requires research and teaching qualifications equivalent to those typically achieved through a successful period of employment as an Assistant Professor although equivalent qualifications may also have been acquired through other means. To obtain permanent employment as an Associate Professor at Aarhus BSS, candidates must, prior to appointment, have completed the faculty’s supervision course and the faculty’s course in Online and Blended Learning offered by the Centre for Educational Development at Aarhus University. If these courses have not been completed prior to employment, appointment will be conditional upon their completion within five years.

About Us

At the Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, we conduct social science research within the field of alcohol and drug studies. Our research projects focus on areas including treatment, prevention and harm reduction, policy, law enforcement, and recreational substance use. We study both legal and illegal substances. The Centre is interdisciplinary, and staff members have backgrounds in fields such as anthropology, psychology, sociology, criminology, and public health. Our aim is to establish and conduct research projects, provide teaching, disseminate knowledge about alcohol and drug problems, develop interventions, and collaborate with national stakeholders and international research institutions. For more information about the Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, please visit www.crf.au.dk.

The Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research is part of the Department of Psychology, Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University. The Department of Psychology is one of six departments within Aarhus BSS, one of the University’s five faculties. Aarhus BSS brings together the core business and social science disciplines to reflect the close relationship between society and business. Aarhus University is ranked among the world’s top 100 universities, and Aarhus BSS and the Department of Psychology have obtained the prestigious AACSB and AMBA accreditations.

Further Information

For further information regarding the position, please contact: Bagga Bjerge, Director, Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, Tel.: +45 22 35 19 89. Email: bb.crf@psy.au.dk

If you require assistance with uploading your application or have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: Charlotte Thomsen, HR-Coordinator. Tel.: +45 87 16 53 62. Email: Charlotte@au.dk.

The place of employment is: Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, Bartholins Allé 9, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark

Application deadline
12 January 2027

International applicant? 
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information here:
https://internationalstaff.au.dk/relocationservice/

Please find more information about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: http://international.au.dk/research/

Terms of employment
Salary and terms of employment are governed by the Cirkulære om overenskomst for akademikere i staten  (in Danish). You will be employed as associate professor at base pay level 4–8 with additional supplements in accordance with the Cirkulære om protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter (in Danish).

The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• Application
• Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave without research activity, including, for example, maternity leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time
• Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree)
• List of publications (the enclosed publications must be clearly marked on the list of publications)
• Publications. Up to five publications can be included in the application. In the event of several authors the publications must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning the applicant's share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors. This template may be used for the purpose
• Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here
 Materials which cannot be uploaded together with the application may be submitted in five copies to Aarhus BSS HR & PhD, Aarhus University, Bartholins Allé 16, DK-8000 Aarhus C.

Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here

The evaluation process
After the application deadline, an assessment committee is appointed. Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline. For further information, see Guidelines for Assessment Committee, Aarhus BSS.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion.
